findings.text: the retirement branch has no source_type guard: the subquery at :2532 filters only on name liveness and on the absence of another non-stale producer, then resolves a successor with OPTIONAL MATCH (old:IMASNode {id: sns.source_id}) at :2544, so a signals source — whose source_id is a FacilitySignal id and never matches an IMASNode — always takes 'WHEN succ IS NULL THEN $retire' and supersedes its name with a removed_path_retirement receipt whose reason reads 'the source path was removed and has no successor'. reconcile_standard_name_sources('signals') calls mark_sources_stale at graph_audits.py:626 and is invoked at provenance_rebuild.py:526, so every StartupName whose last non-stale producer was a FacilitySignal that disappears is now retired, a behaviour the plan scopes to DD removal and which the manifest's own evidence_inputs states is unaffected ('Signal sources are unaffected'); no test covers it.

the inline supersede clause and its receipts duplicate a capability the repository already owns at imas_codex/standard_names/source_invariant.py:42 — _supersede_update writes the same SET of name_stage/status/claimed_at/claim_token plus the same (successor)-[:REFINED_FROM]->(name) edge, supersede_drained_name_cypher(embedded=True) at :58 exists precisely for a writer that must stay one statement, and record_supersede_receipts at :105 writes the same StandardNameChange receipt the code calls record_standard_name_change for directly at :2632 and :2642; the fork also drops the owner's REFINED_FROM-cycle and derived-parent exemptions, so the two supersede paths can diverge.

the done-when asks that tests/standard_names and tests/graph each add no failure id, and only a tests/standard_names arm exists: baseline_suite and after_suite both target tests/standard_names/, and no log under test_logs covers tests/graph, so one half of the stated measure is unmeasured rather than satisfied (the exposure is small — the only tests/graph file naming this code, tests/graph/test_dd_lifecycle.py:106, inspects graph_audits.py, which the node did not change).

the tests: line carries a template command — 'PYTHONPATH=<arm tree> uv run --no-sync --project <arm tree> pytest ... --rootdir <arm tree>' — which cannot be re-run as written and is refused by the manifest's own rule against an unsubstituted placeholder; the literal commands do survive in baseline_suite and after_suite on lines 16-17, so the gate receipt is not lost.
